agent: agent wave, reader D (the plan's stance, powers and objectives)
question: What CEU3AI::UpdateUnitStances, CAIUnit::UpdatePlanPower and the power estimators, CEU3AI::GenerateUnitObjectives and RebuildPriorityProvinces, and the three plan commands write into a theatre's plan, and how the start save's plans come out of them

addresses.name: CEU3AI::UpdateUnitStances
addresses.comment:
**The AI's choice of every unit agent's ground stance, and its air and naval stance 2.** 0x4912D0 to the `ret 8` at 0x491BCA, with the `vector<T> too long` throw at 0x491BCD-0x491BD7 after it; 0x491BE0 is a separate function (fresh SEH prologue after nine int3) - the record used to give this body a second exit at 0x492182, which is that function's. One caller, ProcessAI at 0x489B8F, every hour for a country the AI runs, `force` = (hour of day == (id + 16) % 24).

**Gate**: returns at once when `force` is false and **`ai->+0xA9` is set** (`cmp byte [eax+0xA9], 0; jne` at 0x4912FB) - the record had the sense inverted. +0xA9 is set only at the end of this function (0x491BA9), and only when the pass ran to the end and no agent was both at war on its frontier and without an ops area; nothing clears it (the constructor zeroes it at 0x48813A). So the pass runs every hour until it first completes cleanly, then once a day at hour (id+16)%24.

**Loop 1** over `ai->+0x40` (0x491350-0x491618), per agent A: unit = slot 74; **a null unit ends the whole function** (0x49136F), +0xA9 left clear. If `A->+0x364` (frontier at war) is clear, `A->+0xD0` = 0. Otherwise: climb A's parents (+0x40) to the root agent; if the root is a CAIUnit (slot 65) and its theatre id (+0x68/+0x6C) resolves, walk that theatre's fronts (CTheatre +0x50) and for each **hot** front (CAreaBorder +0x28) whose enemy (+0x1C/+0x20) is not already in A's local list: add it there and, if new, to a list over all agents; then where the enemy is not this country and (`country->diplomacy[enemy]->war` is set, or the enemy is REB, or we are REB) add `unit->plan.their_power / 1000` to A's sum - so the sum is their_power once per distinct at-war enemy of the theatre. `A->+0xD0` = that sum, the total over agents adds it, and the agent with the smallest sum (seed 1e7, 0x160A7CC) is remembered.

**Loop 2** (0x491630-0x491B99), per agent with a unit: if `plan.air_stance != 2 || plan.naval_stance != 2` post `CSetPlanAttributesCommand(unit, 5, 2, 2, -1000, -1000)` (0x4916AD). `A->+0xD0` = 1.0 when it equals the total, else `1 - A->+0xD0 / total` when the total is above 0, else 0 (nothing reads it after). Then:
- `plan.ops_area` count (CUnit +0x21C) is 0: the stance is left alone; if the frontier is at war the pass is marked unfinished.
- frontier not at war: stance **1**.
- frontier at war: r = 10.0, or `(our_power/1000)/(their_power/1000)` (float) when their_power > 0; r x 0.5 when more than one distinct hot enemy was found over all agents and this agent is not the one with the smallest sum. g = 10.0, or `friendSum / enemySum` when enemySum > 0, where enemySum = sum of `CCountry +0xCC / 1000` (army_combat_value) over the distinct enemies, and friendSum the same over the distinct countries in any enemy's `ControllerNeighbours` (+0xFE8) for which `CCountry::IsFriend(that, &ai->tag, true)` holds. v = `A->+0x368` (the front-coverage float slot 73 refreshes from 0x4DCAE0) x r. **v < 0.99 -> 2; v < 1.98 -> 3; else 4; and when it was 3 or 4 and g < 0.9, one less** (clamped 0..4, 0x491B46).

The stance is applied through slot 77 (CAIUnit::SetPlanStance, `[vftable+0x134]` at 0x491B92) **only when it differs from `plan.stance` (CUnit +0x208)**. Stance 0 (withdraw) is never chosen here. Every number is a compiled-in literal: 1e7, 10.0, 0.5, 0.99, 1.98, 0.9, 1.0, 1000.0 (0x160A7CC, 0x171DBB0, 0x160A308, 0x160A810, 0x160A808, 0x160A568, 0x171DBAC/0x160A248, 0x160A300).
addresses.evidence: Revised: extent, gate sense and the arithmetic. Read whole on the listing 0x4912D0-0x491BD7 (disasm.py) and against Ghidra's decompilation, which agrees step for step; constants read off the image as floats/doubles (1e7, 1.0, 10.0, 0.5, 0.99, 1.98, 0.9, 1000.0). Extent: 0x491BD7 int3 x9, 0x491BE0 push ebp/SEH prologue. Gate: the only byte store to +0xA9 in .text is 0x891BA9 (`mov byte [ecx+0xA9], 1`; dispscan of the four displacement bytes, positive control +0xA6 finds its five known writers), and the CEU3AI constructor's `mov word [edi+0xA8], bx` at 0x88813A zeroes it. Save check: on Germany1936_01_04_12 every one of the 90 theatres with an ops area and a peaceful frontier is stance 1, the 16 with no ops area keep the constructor's 2, Ethiopia (at war, our 1.428 vs their 10.037) is 2 and Italy's Cdo. Sup. Africa (16.581 vs 0.270) is 4; air and naval 2 on all 106. Wrong if a second writer of +0xA9 exists that the byte scan cannot see (a dword or memset over +0xA8).

addresses.name: CAIUnit::SetPlanStance
addresses.comment: **Slot 77.** 0x4C36F0 to the `ret 4` at 0x4C38BD. Sets `this->+0x80` (stance_set) = 1 first; then, only if the agent has a unit: posts `CSetPlanAttributesCommand(unit, stance, 3, 3, -1000, -1000)` (ground stance only; 3 and the negatives are the command's leave-alone sentinels), **calls slot 77 with the same stance on every child agent** (CAIAgent +0x44 list, depth first, so the commands queue parent first), then CAIUnit::UpdatePlanAxis (0x4C3330); when the stance is 0, CAIUnit::RebuildOpsAreaProvinceRecords(this, &this->+0x90) (0x4BCD60); then CAIUnit::ScoreOpsAreaProvinces (0x4BD270); then every division on the held-back vector +0x15C has its `+0x2C8` (held-back) byte cleared, `this->+0x86` (replan_subordinates) is set for each, and the vector is emptied. So a change of stance releases the agent's reserve and asks for a slot-78 pass. Callers: CEU3AI::UpdateUnitStances at 0x491B92 (only when the value changes) and the interface.
addresses.evidence: Revised: the tail after the recursion was recorded as only `0x4C3330(this)`. Read on the listing 0x4C36F0-0x4C38BD: `cmp [edi+0x64],0; mov byte [edi+0x80],1; je 0x8C38AD` at 0x8C3710, the recursion through [vftable+0x134] at 0x8C3818, `call 0x8C3330` at 0x8C382A, `cmp [ebp+8],0; jne; call 0x8BCD60` at 0x8C382F, `call 0x8BD270` at 0x8C3844, the +0x15C loop writing `[edx+0x2C8]=0` and `[edi+0x86]=1` at 0x8C3860-0x8C387A, and the erase at 0x8C389D. Ghidra's decompilation agrees. Wrong if 0x8C38AD were reachable with a unit present other than by the je.

addresses.name: CAIUnit::UpdatePlanPower
addresses.comment: **The writer of `our_power` and `their_power` for every country the AI runs.** `this->+0x35C` = 0, `this->+0x358` = CAIUnit_SumOurPower(this, &+0x35C); `this->+0x360` = 0, `this->+0x354` = CAIUnit::EstimateTheatreNeed(this, &+0x360); then posts `CSetPlanAttributesCommand(unit, 5, 3, 3, +0x35C, +0x360)` - powers only - **only when the whole part of either figure differs from the plan's**: `plan.our_power / 1000 != new / 1000 || plan.their_power / 1000 != new / 1000`, C integer division (0x4B50BC-0x4B5115). It is not 'more than a thousandth': a plan holding 0.524 keeps it while the estimate stays under 1.000. Two callers: CAIUnit::SetUnit (slot 63) at 0x4BA02E, right after it posts the activation and runs slot 78, and 0x48E490 at 0x48E553, which ProcessAI runs at the country's hour `id % 24` (when 0x48DCF0 answers false and CEU3AI +0xA5 is set) for every agent whose root theatre resolves. So for an AI country the plan's powers move only when a whole number is crossed, at most once a day.
addresses.evidence: Revised: the gate's description and the second caller. The gate read on the listing: `imul 0x10624DD3; sar edx,6` on both sides (divide by 1000) then `cmp ecx,eax; jne post` and `cmp [ebp-0x10],ecx; je skip`. Save check: between Germany1936_01_04_12 and _01_07_14 the powers of 7 theatres changed and in every one at least one figure crossed a whole number (8.890->9.025, 11.270->12.318, 1.735->2.982, 2.990->3.004, 2.315->3.174, 7.426->6.691, 10.802->11.782); the other 99 are unchanged. Between the hourly saves _01_08_03 -> _01_08_06 only Japan (id 5) and Ethiopia (id 75, hour 3) changed and _01_08_06 -> _01_08_07 only France (id 6), each in the hour its id % 24 gives. Wrong if a plan's power changed without a whole number crossed.

addresses.name: CAIUnit_SumOurPower
addresses.comment: **our_power, in full.** For each unit on the agent's land vector CAIUnit +0x11C (slot 78 fills it with every land unit of the country whose nearest agent up the order of battle is this one) whose `oob_level` is 4 - a division - `p = CUnit::GetPower` (slot 27). Then, unless the division is moving (`+0x2CC > 0`), or its order (+0xB0) is of a kind other than 0x4E5 and 0x56C **and** answers true to its slot 24, or the agent's plan stance (CUnit +0x208) is 3 or more: `p = p * (1000 + fortLevel * 80) / 1000`, fortLevel = `province(+0x130)->modifiers[FORT_LEVEL] / 1000` in whole levels (the 80 an inlined floor(80.5f)). `*powerOut += p`; answers the number of divisions counted. Free function: `agent` on the stack, `ret 8` (trap 11). One caller, 0x4B508E.
addresses.evidence: Revised: the fort condition was ambiguous in the record ('neither kind ... or answers false to slot 24'); the listing 0x8B94E3-0x8B953A is: jg skip if moving; kind 0x4E5 -> fort; kind 0x56C -> fort; else slot 24 (vf+0x60) true -> skip; then stance >= 3 -> skip. Save check, with a calculator that values each brigade by GetSubUnitDefinitionCombatValue of its type's unit file plus its own technology levels times each technology's effect: the frozen sub-1.000 our_power of 46 of the 63 such theatres in Germany1936_01_04_12 equals this sum over the order of battle of Germany1936_01_01_00 exactly (all nine 0.063s, Copenhagen 0.188, Oslo 0.144, Stockholm 0.520 ...); Kwantung Army Theater's 40.084, posted between _01_08_03 and _01_08_06, equals the sum over _01_08_06 (40084); Ethiopia's 1.383, posted in the same window, lies between the sums over _01_08_03 (1380) and _01_08_06 (1386). France's Paris and Bordeaux HQs come out 0.5% low (14946/17106 against 15.017/17.167), not explained. Wrong if a theatre's figure needs a unit outside its own subtree.

addresses.name: CEU3AI::GenerateUnitObjectives
addresses.comment:
**The AI's plan objectives.** `ret 4`; one caller, ProcessAI at 0x489AA8, at the country's hour `id % 24` right after RebuildPriorityProvinces. For **every** unit agent on `ai->+0x40` with a unit and a theatre (CAIUnit::GetArea, which climbs to the root agent - so a subordinate agent gets its theatre's list too):
1. **Only a hot theatre** (CTheatre +0x70) builds a list. Over its fronts (+0x50) in order, a front counts when it is hot (+0x28) or its enemy (+0x1C) is front-worthy (CAIStrategy::IsFrontWorthyEnemy); for each of its provinces in order and each edge not of kind 3, the neighbour must be simulated (template +0x13D) and have a real owner area (slot 0); the area's first province's controller (or `---` for an empty area) must be front-worthy; the area joins a list (each once, in the order met).
2. For each listed area and each of its provinces (+0x24 list, in order): `priority = victory_points (CMapProvince +0x34) x 20` + the value of the province's entry in the country's **strategy `conquer_prov`** (CAIStrategy +0x1C = CCountry +0x4A8; entry +0x8 province, +0xC value) + **100** if the province is in `ai->+0x118` (RebuildPriorityProvinces). Kept when `priority >= 1`, as a CObjective { province, priority, invasion 0, hold 0 } appended in that order.
3. A test meant to drop a province another agent's theatre is nearer to is compiled so it **never fires**: for each other agent's root theatre it walks that theatre's areas (+0x84) and looks in each area A's neighbour links (COwnerArea +0x34, COwnerAreaLink {other, count}) for a link whose `other` is A itself (0x4985E5 compares with A, not with the candidate's area) - and COwnerArea::AdjustNeighbour never links an area to itself - so the distance comparison (CAIUnit::DistanceToTheatreFronts, rva 0xB08C0) at 0x4985F3 is never reached and nothing is dropped.
4. Posted as `CSetPlanObjectivesCommand(unit, &list)` unless the list has the plan's objective count (CUnit +0x23C) and every new objective matches an existing one on province and priority. **A theatre that is not hot builds an empty list, so a plan that had objectives gets them cleared.**
addresses.evidence: Revised: the area collection, invasion (always 0 - `mov [eax+0x10], ebx` at 0x898654 with ebx re-zeroed at 0x898401; the record said 'from a local'), the unreachable drop and the clearing. Read on the listing 0x8980E0-0x898850 and the decompilation. Save check, Germany1936_01_04_12: Italy's Cdo. Sup. Africa (the only hot AI theatre besides Ethiopia's) carries 10 objectives - 7445 (20), 5567 (20), 5589 (100), 5563 (100), 5586 (100), 5611 (40), 9943 Addis Ababa (40), 5160 (80), 5412 (60), 5134 (100) - every priority exactly 20 x the province's points in tfh/history/provinces (or history/provinces), Italy holding no conquer_prov and +0x118 empty; they are British, Ethiopian and French provinces, areas that touch the theatre's fronts and whose controller is front-worthy to Italy. Ethiopia's hot theatre faces Italian East Africa, whose provinces have no points, so it has none; no other AI theatre is hot, so 105 plans carry no objective. By _04_20_03 the Italian plan has none (cleared). The 'never fires' rests on AdjustNeighbour (0x7EAD0, `cmp esi, edi` at entry) being the only maker of links, as the record says; wrong if any other code puts a self-link on COwnerArea +0x34.

addresses.name: CEU3AI::RebuildPriorityProvinces
addresses.comment: **Fills `ai->+0x118`, the provinces allies have asked this country to take**, which is worth +100 on an AI objective's priority. One caller, ProcessAI at 0x489A93, at hour `id % 24`, just before GenerateUnitObjectives. Frees the list; then, **only when the country is at war (CCountry +0xACC)**: a list L of countries - every other member of its faction (when the faction is real, slot 7) that is itself at war, then every country of `non_hostile_countries` (CCountry +0xF98) not already in L and not itself; then for each country Y in L, every record of `CGameState +0xBAC` (allied_objectives_by_requester)[Y] whose countries vector holds our id appends the record's province id to +0x118 (duplicates kept). So a province an at-war ally or co-belligerent has marked as an allied objective for us gets +100.
addresses.evidence: Revised from likely: the source of the ids, now that CGameState +0xBAC is recorded as allied_objectives_by_requester. Read on the listing (0x897703-0x897731 free, 0x89773C `cmp byte [eax+0xACC],0; je` the war gate, the faction walk, the non_hostile walk, the +0xBAC walk) and the decompilation. In Germany1936_01_04_12 no save carries allied_objectives and Italy's objectives show no +100, which agrees. Wrong if +0xBAC's per-country records are not the requester-indexed half.

addresses.name: CSetPlanObjectivesCommand::CSetPlanObjectivesCommand
addresses.signature: CSetPlanObjectivesCommand* __stdcall CSetPlanObjectivesCommand::CSetPlanObjectivesCommand(CSetPlanObjectivesCommand* this, CUnit* unit, CList* objectives)
addresses.comment: Builds the command (0x74 bytes): save token 0x70B at +0x2C/+0x30, the unit reference through 0x42DD70 into +0x3C, vftable 0x15C935C, and **a copy of every CObjective of the given list** into its own list at +0x64 (head, tail, count, byte at +0x70) through 0x5EBEA0, walking the source by node +0x1C. `ret 0xC`, returns this. Two callers: CEU3AI::GenerateUnitObjectives (0x898767) and CAIUnit::DistributeObjectives (0x8C1B87).
addresses.evidence: Read on the listing 0x5E68B0-0x5E697A: `mov esi,[ebp+8]` (this), the token stores, `call 0x42DD70` on +0x3C, the zeroing of +0x64..+0x70 and the copy loop calling 0x5EBEA0, `ret 0xC`. Callers by findRefs.py --callers. Wrong if a caller cleans the stack itself.

addresses.name: CSetPlanObjectivesCommand::Execute
addresses.comment: Slot 6. Resolves the unit (+0x40/+0x44 through FindPersistentById, -8 to the CUnit) and calls `CUnitPlan::CopyObjectives(&unit->plan, &this->+0x64)` (0x4DEE60), which frees the plan's objective list (CUnitPlan +0x38, CUnit +0x234) and copies the command's in: **the plan's objectives are replaced wholesale**, nothing else is touched (no force-needs refresh). Like its siblings it has no null check of its own; an invalid command is refused before slot 6.
addresses.evidence: The class's slot 6 (vtable.py CSetPlanObjectivesCommand: 0x5E6980). Read whole on the listing 0x5E6980-0x5E69F7: the two-table lookup, `add eax,-8`, `add esi,0x64; push esi; add eax,0x1FC; call 0x8DEE60`, bare ret. CopyObjectives read at 0x8DEE60: frees +0x38's nodes, zeroes head/tail/count, copies through 0x8E3260. Wrong if 0x8E3260 merges rather than appends.

addresses.name: CActivateUnitPlanCommand::CActivateUnitPlanCommand
addresses.signature: CActivateUnitPlanCommand* __stdcall CActivateUnitPlanCommand::CActivateUnitPlanCommand(CActivateUnitPlanCommand* this, CUnit* unit, bool active, bool allowHqReorg)
addresses.comment: Builds the command (0x68 bytes): save token 0x706, the unit reference into +0x3C, `+0x64 = active`, `+0x65 = allowHqReorg`. `ret 0x10`. Four callers: CAIUnit slot 54 (0x8B0652) and slot 64 ClearUnit (0x8BA1DA) pass (unit, 0, 0) - switch the plan off, which resets it; slot 63 SetUnit (0x8B9F72) passes (unit, 1, unit->plan.allow_hq_reorg); the battle-plan objectives panel (0x74FCB8) passes (unit, 1, its own flag).
addresses.evidence: Read on the listing 0x5E5350-0x5E53F4: `mov esi,[ebp+8]`, token 0x706 at +0x2C/+0x30, `call 0x42DD70`, `mov cl,[ebp+0x10]; mov dl,[ebp+0x14]; mov [esi+0x64],cl; mov [esi+0x65],dl`, `ret 0x10`. Each caller's four pushes read before the call (slot 63 loads `[ecx+0x205]`, CUnit plan +0x9). Wrong if a caller passes the flags in another order.

addresses.name: CActivateUnitPlanCommand::Execute
addresses.comment:
Virtual slot 6 - the command's own Execute, the same shape as CSetPlanAttributesCommand::Execute next door. It resolves its unit reference (`this->+0x40`/`+0x44` through FindPersistentById against [0x1A857F0] or [0x1A857F4] by whether the type half exceeds 0x1268, then `-8` to reach the CUnit), calls `CUnitPlan::SetActive(&unit->plan (+0x1FC), this->+0x64)` at 0x1E5451, and then writes `this->+0x65` to the plan's `allow_hq_reorg` byte (CUnitPlan +0x9, CUnit +0x205) - the whole of the command.

**It matters to plan_air_stance because SetActive(plan, 0) resets the whole plan**, air_stance included: deactivating a plan puts air_stance back to 1. This is one of only three callers of SetActive, the other two being CUnitPlan::ApplyToUnit (0x1D0F16) and CSetPlanAttributesCommand::Execute (0x1E7822), and the last of those always passes 1 because its constructor hardcodes `+0x64 = 1`.

The failure arm is the same as its sibling's: a lookup that fails falls through to `xor eax,eax` and the plan pointer becomes 0x1FC, which survives only because an invalid command is rejected before slot 6 is reached.
addresses.evidence: Revised: 'then goes on to the rest of the command' replaced by what the rest is. The decompilation and the listing both show the second lookup and the byte store at unit + 0x205 (persistent pointer + 0x1FD), then return. CUnitPlan +0x9 is already recorded as allow_hq_reorg. Wrong if +0x205 were a CUnit field outside the plan.

addresses.name: PlanStanceName
addresses.comment: The localised name of a battle plan's ground stance: a jump table on 0..4 (0x8E0230) picks **0 `STANCE_WITHDRAW`, 1 `STANCE_PREPARE`, 2 `STANCE_DEFEND`, 3 `STANCE_ATTACK`, 4 `STANCE_BLITZ`** (Withdraw / Prepare / Defensive / Attacking / Blitzing Stance in the base game's localisation). Interface only (callers 0x46EA19, 0x471DC5, 0x7507DE, 0x7513BB). The name is ours.
addresses.evidence: `cmp eax,4; ja; jmp [eax*4+0x8E0230]` at 0x8DFF2C; the table read off the image is 0x8DFF3C, 0x8DFFC5, 0x8E0052, 0x8E00DF, 0x8E0172, whose first instructions load the five strings at 0x15EC21C/22C/23C/24C/25C in that order (strrefs.py: each string referenced only there). Output in EDI (`mov eax, edi` before the bare ret; EDI is not saved by the prologue). Wrong if the caller passes the stance biased.

addresses.name: PlanAirStanceName
addresses.comment: The localised name of a plan's air stance: **0 `STANCE_AIR_PREPARE`, 1 `STANCE_AIR_DEFEND`, 2 `STANCE_AIR_ATTACK`** (Air Prepare: only rebase and reorganise; Air Defensive: also intercept; Air Offensive: the full range of missions), anything else an empty string. Interface only. The name is ours.
addresses.evidence: `sub eax,ebx; je 0x8E0785; dec eax; je 0x8E06CD; dec eax; je 0x8E060F` at 0x8E05C7; the three arms push 0x15EC2D4 (AIR_PREPARE), 0x15EC2E8 (AIR_DEFEND), 0x15EC2FC (AIR_ATTACK). Output is ECX (`mov esi, ecx`), bare ret. Agrees with the air body's phase 4 being off at 0 and its strategic arm needing 2 (FINDINGS-airstance.md).

addresses.name: PlanNavalStanceName
addresses.comment: The localised name of a plan's naval stance: **0 `STANCE_NAVAL_PREPARE`, 1 `STANCE_NAVAL_DEFEND`, 2 `STANCE_NAVAL_ATTACK`** (only rebase and reorganise / also defend the coasts / the full range of missions), anything else an empty string. The same body shape as PlanAirStanceName. Interface only. The name is ours.
addresses.evidence: Same dispatch at 0x8E0B67-0x8E0B7F to 0x8E0D25, 0x8E0C6D, 0x8E0BAF, which load 0x15EC358 (NAVAL_PREPARE), 0x15EC370 (NAVAL_DEFEND) and 0x15EC384 (NAVAL_ATTACK) - strrefs.py, one reference each. Output in ECX, bare ret.

struct_fields.name: stances_settled
struct_fields.comment: Set by CEU3AI::UpdateUnitStances (0x4912D0) at 0x491BA9 when a pass ran to the end and no agent was at war on its frontier without an ops area; **while it is set**, a call without `force` returns at once (0x4912F3-0x491301) - so the stance pass runs every hour until it first settles and then only at the daily hour (id + 16) % 24. Zeroed by the constructor (`mov word [edi+0xA8], bx` at 0x48813A) and never cleared.
struct_fields.evidence: Revised: the record had the sense inverted ('returns when this byte is clear') and the name with it. `cmp byte [eax+0xA9], bl(0); jne 0x891BB9` at 0x8912FB. The only byte store found by scanning .text for the displacement's four bytes is 0x891BA9 (=1); positive control: the same scan finds all five writers of +0xA6 including 0x889852.

struct_fields.name: stance_enemy_power
struct_fields.comment: Scratch of CEU3AI::UpdateUnitStances: in its first loop the agent's theatre's their_power summed once per distinct at-war enemy of its hot fronts (0 when the frontier is not at war, 0x49160C), in its second `1 - this / total over agents` (1.0 when equal, 0 when the total is 0). No reader found after that.
struct_fields.evidence: Stores at 0x4915F6, 0x49160C, 0x4917AA, load at 0x491757; the CAIUnit constructor stores at 0x4AF5FC. A scan of every float load/store with displacement 0xD0 in .text finds no other access in the AI module (0x880000-0x8F0000); positive control: it finds those five. An integer `mov` read would not show in that scan, and +0xD0 is too common an integer displacement (CMapProvince's id) to settle by a bare scan.

struct_fields.name: strategy_conquer_prov_first
struct_fields.comment: Not a field of its own: it is the live strategy's `conquer_prov` list (CAIStrategy +0x1C of the strategy embedded at +0x48C), 16-byte nodes with the province id at payload +0x8 and the value at +0xC. CEU3AI::GenerateUnitObjectives adds the matching entry's value to an objective's priority (0x498470-0x4984A0).
struct_fields.evidence: Revised: 'what fills it was not traced'. 0x48C + 0x1C = 0x4A8, and the decompilation of 0x4980E0 types the access as `country->Strategy.conquer_prov` from the record's own CAIStrategy layout. The save's `ai` block writes these as `conquer_prov={ id value }`; Italy has none in Germany1936_01_04_12 and none of its objective priorities carries an addition beyond 20 x points.

struct_fields.name: active
struct_fields.comment: Whether the plan is switched on (the save's `active`). Set by CUnitPlan::SetActive: to 1 by every CSetPlanAttributesCommand (its constructor hardcodes +0x64 = 1, so the AI's air/naval-stance post activates every agent's plan) and by CActivateUnitPlanCommand(unit, 1, ...) from CAIUnit::SetUnit and the objectives panel; to 0, with a full reset of the plan, by CActivateUnitPlanCommand(unit, 0, 0) from CAIUnit slots 54 and 64.
struct_fields.evidence: Revised: comment only. Constructor arguments at the four CActivateUnitPlanCommand call sites read on the listing; SetActive's callers as the record has them. All 106 plans in Germany1936_01_04_12 are active=yes and every one has air/naval stance 2, which only the activating command writes.

struct_fields.name: stance
struct_fields.comment: The ground stance, 0..4: **0 withdraw, 1 prepare, 2 defend, 3 attack, 4 blitz** (STANCE_WITHDRAW .. STANCE_BLITZ, PlanStanceName). The constructor and a reset give 2; CAIUnit slot 76's theatre adoption posts 1; CEU3AI::UpdateUnitStances gives 1 to an agent with an ops area whose frontier is not at war and 2, 3 or 4 by the power and coverage ratios when it is.
struct_fields.evidence: Revised: comment only (values named). The jump table of 0x4DFF00 maps 0..4 to the five keys in this order. Germany1936_01_04_12: 88 theatres at 1, 17 at 2 (16 with no ops area, Ethiopia), Italy's Africa at 4.

struct_fields.name: naval_stance
struct_fields.comment: The naval stance, 0..2: **0 prepare, 1 defend, 2 attack** (STANCE_NAVAL_*, PlanNavalStanceName). Constructed and reset to 1; the AI's slot 76 posts 0 and CEU3AI::UpdateUnitStances drives every agent's to 2.
struct_fields.evidence: Revised: comment only. 0x4E0B40's dispatch; the two AI posts at 0x4DAD74 and 0x4916AD.

struct_fields.name: our_power
struct_fields.comment: The save's `our_power`, thousandths of CUnit::GetPower units. For an AI country it is CAIUnit_SumOurPower's figure - every division under the agent, `(strength/100) x typeValue / 1000 x (organisation/100) / 1000` per brigade, +8% per fort level for a division standing still under a stance below 3 - posted by CAIUnit::UpdatePlanPower only when its whole part changes; for a human's delegated plan 0x4B60F0's plain sum over every land unit. A negative value in CSetPlanAttributesCommand means 'leave it'.
struct_fields.evidence: Revised: comment only. See CAIUnit_SumOurPower's evidence: 46 of 63 frozen sub-1.000 figures of Germany1936_01_04_12 reproduced exactly from the order of battle of _01_01_00, Kwantung's 40.084 from _01_08_06.

struct_fields.name: their_power
struct_fields.comment: The save's `their_power`: CAIUnit::EstimateTheatreNeed's out-figure, the weighted GetPower of foreign land units on the front provinces the agent's ops area faces (CAIUnit +0xC0), posted with our_power under the same whole-number gate. 0 while the plan has no ops area. A negative value in CSetPlanAttributesCommand means 'leave it'.
struct_fields.evidence: Revised: comment only. In Germany1936_01_04_12 all 16 theatres without an ops area have their_power 0.000. The 0-without-an-ops-area rule rests on EstimateAreaNeed walking only +0xC0 (FINDINGS-power.md), which is rebuilt from the ops area - inferred, not re-read here.
